memes.name: Ramanan
memes.format: Used to describe someone who is constantly failing or being made fun of.
memes.example_comeback: Don't act like a Ramanan here.

memes.name: Dashamoolam Damu
memes.format: Showing fake courage but actually scared.
memes.example_comeback: Nee oru Dashamoolam Damu aavan nokkanda.

memes.name: Manavalan
memes.example_comeback: Manavalan style-il thallan nokkuvaano?

memes.name: Pavanan
memes.format: Someone who gets beaten up but pretends it's nothing.
memes.example_comeback: Pavanayi shavamayi. That's you right now.

memes.name: Polandine patti
memes.example_comeback: Stop talking about Poland and face the truth.

memes.name: Gafoor ka dost
memes.example_comeback: Nee Gafoor ka dost aano ithra thallan?

memes.name: Kumbalangi Shammi smile
memes.example_comeback: Stop giving me that Shammi smile.

memes.name: Kochi pazhaya Kochi
memes.format: Claiming you haven't changed your badass ways.
memes.example_comeback: Kochi pazhaya Kochi alla, njanum.

memes.name: Oru load pucham
memes.format: Looking at someone with extreme disdain.
memes.example_comeback: *Oru load pucham* is all you deserve.

memes.name: Chathi
memes.example_comeback: Edi/Eda... chathikko?

memes.name: Enthu patti
memes.format: Acting totally unbothered when someone expects a reaction.
memes.example_comeback: Enikku enthu patti? Oru kuzhappavum illa.

memes.name: Scene contra
memes.format: When a situation turns very bad.
memes.example_comeback: Nee kooduthal paranjal scene contra aavum.

memes.name: Njan enthu cheyyana
memes.example_comeback: Ninne kandal njan enthu cheyyana?

memes.name: Purushu anugrahikkanam
memes.example_comeback: Oh, Purushu enne anugrahikkanam!

memes.name: Vattalle
memes.example_comeback: Ninakku vattalle? Athu apozhe paranjille.

memes.name: Chaambikko
memes.format: A cool sign-off or ordering to take action.
memes.example_comeback: Njan parayunne theernnu. Chaambikko!

memes.name: Adipoli
memes.example_comeback: Adipoli, nannayittundu ninte thallu.

memes.name: Katta local
memes.example_comeback: Your attitude is katta local.

memes.name: Aaraada
memes.example_comeback: Nee aaraada enikku class edukkan?

memes.name: Appoz pinne
memes.format: Looking for the next bad thing.
memes.example_comeback: Appoz pinne ninte karyam njan parayanno?
